dataset_metadata.name: ISL Continuous Fingerspelling & Sentence Benchmark (Dataset C)
dataset_metadata.publication_reference: Kiran et al., 'Indian Sign Language Continuous Fingerspelling Recognition', ACL Anthology (kirandevraj.github.io/ISL-Fingerspelling)
dataset_metadata.scope: Continuous signing sequences containing aligned video frames, landmark trajectories, and text transcriptions.
dataset_metadata.distinction_note: Focuses on continuous fingerspelled letter sequences and structured phrases rather than unrestricted conversational ISL with facial grammar.
dataset_metadata.signer_independent_mandate: Train and test splits MUST partition by distinct signer identities (disjoint signers). Evaluating across the same signer produces artificially inflated test metrics.

data_collection_rules.title: Multi-Signer Diversity
data_collection_rules.requirement: Record multiple signers with diverse signing hand dominance, hand sizes, and anatomical proportions.

data_collection_rules.title: Environmental Variation
data_collection_rules.requirement: Record across diverse indoor/outdoor backgrounds, varying lighting conditions (direct, diffuse, low-light), camera distances (0.8m to 2.2m), and camera angles.

data_collection_rules.title: Signing Speed Variation
data_collection_rules.requirement: Capture signs performed at natural conversation speeds, slow articulation, and fast conversational transitions to train temporal models on speed variance.

data_collection_rules.title: Expert ISL Annotation
data_collection_rules.requirement: All boundary timestamps and gloss labels must be verified by certified ISL interpreters or native Deaf signers.

data_collection_rules.title: Disjoint Signer Splits
data_collection_rules.requirement: Clips from signer S_i must be strictly assigned either to Train or Test, never shared across both. Evaluate via Leave-One-Signer-Out (LOSO) cross-validation.

data_collection_rules.title: Explicit Out-of-Vocabulary / Unknown Tracking
data_collection_rules.requirement: Record resting hand poses, ambient conversational gestures, and out-of-vocabulary handshapes to train and evaluate rejection thresholds rather than forcing unknown signs into false positives.

data_collection_rules.title: Informed Consent & Privacy Protocol
data_collection_rules.requirement: Obtain signed, informed consent prior to recording or storing any video data. Provide anonymization options (background blurring and landmark-only skeletal transmission).
